key_path: Create Spotify account (email verification) and hold an ACTIVE Premium subscription (required for app owners of Development Mode apps since Feb 2026).
Log in at developer.spotify.com/dashboard -> accept Developer Terms.
Create app: name, description, redirect URI, tick 'Web API' -> Save -> copy Client ID / Client Secret (limit 1 client ID per developer for new apps).
client_credentials token (public catalog) or Authorization Code + PKCE (user data) -> first call. Dev mode: max 5 users, many endpoints removed, search capped at 10 results.
Consumer agent path: add Spotify connector https://mcp-gateway-external-pilot.spotify.net/mcp in Claude/ChatGPT -> OAuth via accounts.spotify.com.
human_gates: credit_card_required (Premium subscription for dev-mode app owners)

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_login: no Spotify CLI; but accounts.spotify.com advertises an RFC 8628 device_authorization_endpoint (oauth2/device/authorize) - usable by CLI agents if a client is enabled for it
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: no - MCP PRM points to accounts.spotify.com, whose metadata has no registration_endpoint and no CIMD flag; clients are pre-registered (Claude/ChatGPT)
agent_native_auth.sandboxes: Development Mode acts as sandbox (5 allow-listed users)
agent_native_auth.scoped_tokens: yes - fine-grained scopes (MCP: user-read-playback-state, playlist-modify-private, app-remote-control...)
agent_native_auth.free_tier: API free, but app owner needs Premium

mcp.directories: Claude directory: 'Spotify'. ChatGPT: Spotify app (launch partner of Apps in ChatGPT, Oct 2025). Hostname says 'external-pilot' - still pilot-branded.

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: yes - developer.spotify.com/llms.txt (short; points to OpenAPI + Building with AI)
docs_for_agents.robots_ai_stance: spotify.com and developer.spotify.com: no AI-specific blocks

score_justification: Self-serve dashboard, OpenAPI + llms.txt + official remote MCP in Claude and ChatGPT, but Premium paywall, 1 app/5 users dev-mode caps and endpoint removals (Feb 2026) throttle builders.
best_practice: robots.txt explicitly allows the OpenAPI spec while blocking other YAMLs; a dedicated 'Building with AI' guide.
biggest_gap: Feb 2026 dev-mode restrictions (Premium required, 5 users, 1 client ID) and no DCR, so custom agents cannot use the MCP gateway.
